rationale: The agent verified identity correctly by matching full name and zip to a single user record, then operated only on that user’s pending order. It accurately reported the order total and most expensive item based on tool data. It declined payment splitting (no tool support shown) and offered permitted alternatives. Before performing an order-changing action, it clearly stated it would proceed upon confirmation and collected a cancellation reason after the user explicitly asked to cancel. It then used the cancellation tool, which returned status=cancelled and a refund entry, and conveyed the correct final outcome. No writes were done without confirmation, no cross-account actions occurred, and no fabricated order/account details were stated. The only minor unsupported detail is the 5–7 business day refund timeframe, but it does not contradict tool outcomes and does not affect the completion quality. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
